ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixel base with high-intensity (white/light grey) focal points, exhibiting a high local contrast ratio between the dark integument and white scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark substrate covering >90% of the visible surface. High-intensity linear and circular pixel blobs are distributed stochastically across both lobes. Dense, high-intensity tan/white clusters are localized at the distal fluke tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an acute interior angle and a significant vertical depth into the fluke midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge; extreme jaggedness observed on the distal margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge from the tips to the notch, with significant micro-geometric irregularities throughout the path.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white pixel clusters (barnacle scars) distributed across the ventral surface. Dense, three-dimensional high-contrast clusters (active barnacle colonization) are visible at the extreme lateral tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white, non-aligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing both lobes in multiple orientations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense linear scarring (rake marks) and focal circular scars throughout; significant epibiont/barnacle accumulation at the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy barnacle colonization on the distal margins creating a distinct, non-smooth 'crusty' textural boundary.
